# ClothMatics

> ClothMatics is a personal digital wardrobe and outfit-planning service for Android and the web. It organizes clothes a user owns, supports wardrobe-grounded outfit planning, and tracks wardrobe use.

Garment capture and image changes happen in the Android app. The website provides a public product overview and, after authentication, access to the user's private wardrobe companion. Personal wardrobe data is never public.

## Product

- [ClothMatics home](https://clothmatics.pages.dev/): Product overview, core capabilities, mobile/web boundaries, and access to the signed-in wardrobe.
- [About ClothMatics](https://clothmatics.pages.dev/about): Purpose, product boundaries, operating principles, and accountability links.
- [Help and FAQ](https://clothmatics.pages.dev/faq): Factual answers about accounts, wardrobe access, outfits, planning, privacy, account deletion, and troubleshooting.
- [Photo guide](https://clothmatics.pages.dev/photo-guide): Instructions for taking clear full-body outfit and single-garment photos.
- [Google Play](https://clothmatics.pages.dev/r?to=play): Official Android app listing.

## Policies and support

- [Privacy Policy](https://clothmatics.pages.dev/privacy): Data handling, permissions, AI features, retention, user rights, and deletion practices.
- [Terms of Use](https://clothmatics.pages.dev/terms): Terms for accounts, wardrobe services, user content, AI features, plans, and acceptable use.
- [Help and contact](https://clothmatics.pages.dev/contact): Product support, privacy questions, and authenticated account-deletion requests.
